tldr: Deep Relief holds the deep-tissue-massage moat at scale (47 top-3 cells, 1.9× the next competitor) and is gaining top-10 footprint on chiropractor + acupuncture (+24 and +18 top-10 cells Mar 12 → May 15). The bleed is on pregnancy/prenatal massage where Sage Blossom Massage’s second listing (209-review pin) is taking share: pregnancy-massage-near-me top-3 cells 34 → 26 (−8). DataForSEO confirms 15 untracked services where Deep Relief sits #1–#3 at the pin today — including massage therapy austin (590 vol, #1), deep tissue massage austin (590, #1), acupuncture austin (1,000, #1), cupping therapy austin (170, #1), and massage near me (40,500, #2). The strategic play is: defend the deep-tissue moat, counter Sage Blossom on pregnancy, formalize tracking on the at-pin wins, and connect GA4 so conversion stops being invisible.

headline.h2: Deep Relief owns deep-tissue and is widening top-10 reach — the bleed is on pregnancy massage, where Sage Blossom’s newer pin is taking cells.
headline.lede:
Across an 8-keyword 13×13 Local Falcon grid scanned 4 times (Mar 12 → May 15, 2026): portfolio top-10 footprint grew from 328 to 363 cells (+35) — the clinic’s pin is being shown across more of South Austin than before. Top-3 share is flat-to-slightly-down (-11) entirely because of one keyword cluster: pregnancy/prenatal massage, where Sage Blossom Massage’s 209-review listing has accelerated. The deep-tissue-massage category is decisively owned (DR 47 top-3 cells; nearest competitor 25). Cold laser is unwinnable against Laser Therapy Clinic-Austin’s category-exact pin (133/133 cells in top-3) — accept the constraint and stop measuring against it.

GSC: 365 days, 7,839 clicks against 945,867 impressions. Sitewide CTR 0.83% — the bottleneck isn’t reach (impressions +2.8% H2 vs H1), it’s click-capture: brand queries are 3.4% of impressions but 63.8% of clicks, non-brand impressions get 0.4% CTR. GA4 is not connected — conversion-side measurement is the single biggest open question, and the only owner-side ask in this diagnosis.

levers.name: Defend the deep-tissue moat — don't lose ground to growing competitors
levers.why: Deep tissue massage is the only query where Deep Relief has portfolio-defining ownership (47 top-3 cells; nearest competitor Deeply Therapeutic at 25). Slight rank softening (avg 5.07 → 5.51, mean dx -0.13) and 3-cell top-3 loss show this isn't permanent. Sage Blossom’s 209-review listing and AUSTINDEEP Barton Creek are the watch-list.
actions: Sustain GBP posting cadence specifically tagging deep tissue massage on photos + posts.
Schema-mark /services/massage-therapy/ as MedicalTherapy with hasOfferCatalog including DeepTissueMassage.
Internal link the deep tissue massage service page from every top-traffic blog (currently mostly orphaned).
Run /services/deep-tissue-massage-austin/ as a dedicated landing page (currently folded into massage hub).
levers.outcome: Hold 45+ top-3 cells; widen top-10 from 73 to 80+; ensure rank doesn’t drift past 6.0 avg.

levers.name: Counter Sage Blossom on pregnancy/prenatal massage — reverse the bleed
levers.why: Sage Blossom Massage (209-rev listing) holds 62 top-3 cells on pregnancy-massage-near-me to DR’s 26 and is gaining (+6 portfolio-wide). DR lost 8 top-3 cells on pregnancy-massage-near-me alone and dropped #1 cells from 7 to 2. This is the largest single category bleed.
actions: Build a dedicated /services/prenatal-massage-austin/ landing page (currently lives only as a Massage sub-section).
Add pregnancy-massage trust signals to homepage and GBP description: certifications, training, body cushion equipment.
Push 3 prenatal-massage GBP posts per month with client photos (with permission) for the next 90 days.
Run a backlink push targeting Austin Mom blogs, doula directories (Austin Birth Doulas, Austin Childbirth Trust), and prenatal yoga studios for referral + citation.
levers.outcome: Recover 8+ top-3 cells on pregnancy-massage-near-me; widen top-10 reach by 10+ cells.

levers.name: Formalize tracking on the at-pin wins — stop measuring blind
levers.why: DataForSEO Maps SERP at the pin shows Deep Relief sitting at rank #1–#3 for 15 services that are not currently in LD tracking, representing ~48K monthly Austin DMA searches. We can’t defend (or grow) what we don’t measure. Wins we don’t track silently erode.
actions: Add to LD tracking: chiropractor near me (3,600/mo), massage therapy austin (590), deep tissue massage austin (590), acupuncture austin (1,000), cupping therapy austin (170), sports massage austin (320), lymphatic drainage massage austin (1,000), couples massage austin (1,000), massage near me (40,500).
Run baseline LD grid scans on all 9 net-new tracked queries this month.
Re-evaluate priority list next quarter — whatever moves first will signal which deserve dedicated landing pages.
levers.outcome: Add ~50K monthly Austin volume to the tracked surface, with DR already in top-3 position at center.

levers.name: Connect GA4 — close the conversion-side measurement blackout
levers.why: GA4 is not connected. We can see GSC clicks (7,839 in 365d), Maps reach, and competitor movement — but we cannot see leads, calls, bookings, or revenue. With 96.6% of impressions non-brand and 0.4% CTR there, the click → booking ratio is the single most actionable diagnostic we can’t run.
actions: Owner ask: grant info@hqdm.io editor access to the Deep Relief GA4 property (or share property ID if it already exists).

Once connected: rebuild conversion stack (form submits + click_phone + click_email + booking confirmations) and categorize events per BB Massage convention — booking + lead = TRUE conversion, calls = qualified intent, GBP listing taps = engagement-not-conversion.
Wire GTM-side phone-click and form-submit tracking if missing.
levers.outcome: Conversion-side picture matches the maps-side picture; we can attribute lift to the right lever.

levers.name: Click-capture: lift sitewide CTR off 0.83% — the impressions are already there
levers.why: GSC shows 945,867 impressions and only 7,839 clicks (0.83% CTR). Brand queries (3.4% of impressions) earn 63.8% of clicks (~22% CTR); non-brand (96.6% of impressions) earns 0.4% CTR. The supply problem is solved — the demand-capture problem isn’t. Title + meta + result-snippet rewrites are the unblocked work.
actions: Run a title-tag + meta-description rewrite across the top 25 non-brand pages by impressions (priority on those at position 4–15).
Add FAQ / HowTo schema to long-form service pages so the SERP card is fuller.
Build out specific service-page H1s that match high-impression query phrasing (e.g., add “Austin” to service-page titles where the query specifies metro).
A/B observe over 60 days; expand pattern to remaining pages if CTR moves >0.3pp.
levers.outcome: Move sitewide CTR from 0.83% to 1.20%+ within 90 days — a worth ~3,500 additional clicks/yr at current impressions.

levers.name: Concede cold-laser — it’s a category-aligned competitor moat
levers.why: Laser Therapy Clinic-Austin (28 reviews, 3.9★) holds 133/133 top-3 cells on cold-laser-austin at avg rank 2.17 — they’re the exact-name match. Austin Laser Solutions runs 2 locations splitting #2/#3. Deep Relief is currently 8 top-3 cells out of 46 visible — a real position but capped by category mismatch. Spending on this query is low-leverage.
actions: Keep the cold laser landing page; do NOT invest in additional content/links for cold-laser-specific queries.
Re-target the cold-laser landing page to capture ‘cold laser + condition’ long-tail (knee pain, plantar fasciitis, peripheral neuropathy) — fewer competitors there.
Remove cold-laser-specific GBP posting cadence; redirect that production to deep-tissue + pregnancy-massage content.
levers.outcome: Stop wasting attention on an unwinnable surface; redirect to leverage-positive queries.

owner_asks.title: Grant GA4 access for Deep Relief property
owner_asks.why: No GA4 property is registered under HQDM access. Without GA4 we can see search-side performance (clicks, impressions, map rank) but cannot connect that to leads / bookings / revenue. The next quarter’s diagnosis needs this connected.

owner_asks.title: Confirm priority service additions to LD tracking
owner_asks.why: DataForSEO shows Deep Relief at #1-#3 at the pin for 15 untracked services. We recommend adding all 9 to LD; owner can confirm which 4-5 are commercial priorities so we build dedicated landing pages first.

owner_asks.title: Provide pregnancy-massage equipment + certification facts
owner_asks.why: Lever B (countering Sage Blossom on pregnancy massage) needs trust signals on the prenatal page. Specifics on body cushion equipment, practitioner certifications, prenatal training hours, and any obstetrician referral relationships would dramatically strengthen the landing page.
